items.title: How it feels to handle Apple's foldable iPhone Duo
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley joins Market Domination's host Josh Lipton from Cupertino, Calif., at Apple's (AAPL) headquarters to describe how it feels to use the newly unveiled foldable iPhone Duo and its features.

items.title: A foldable iPhone is nice, but Apple still needs to improve its AI user experience
items.summary: Apple (AAPL) is expected to unveil its foldable iPhone on Wednesday at its "Surprise and Shine" event. This will be CEO John Ternus's first product launch as chief executive. Sherwood News head of markets Luke Kawa and Investopedia editor in chief Caleb Silver chat with Morning Brief host Julie Hyman about their expectations for the launch.

items.title: Apple Finds Advantages Across Fintech In Search Results
items.summary: Fintech brands face greater challenges gaining visibility in AI-generated answers than brands in other sectors, but rank well when their product offerings span several categories.

items.title: Stock Market Today, Sept. 9: Meta Surges Over 6.5% on Muse AI Agent Launch

items.title: AMZN, META, GOOGL Might Lose Billions As Ohio State Reconsiders Data Center Tax Breaks, Says Report
items.summary: Ohio is reportedly reconsidering incentives worth billions as states weigh the costs of data center growth and rising demand for power and water.

items.title: Legal AI leaders like Harvey are sprinting to scale while they still can
items.summary: As the big frontier model makers muscle into legal tech, venture dollars are consolidating around a select few leaders who have gone on acquisition sprees. Legal AI provider Harvey’s $550 million raise accounts for 16% of the $3.35 billion invested in legal tech companies globally so far in 2026, according to PitchBook data.
